2609.29947.title: Neuro-symbolic AI for Industrial Configuration
2609.29947.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive performance on a wide range of generative tasks. Yet their probabilistic nature makes them, in isolation, fundamentally unsuited for industrial product configuration, where outputs must be syntactically valid, semantically consistent with a knowledge base of hundreds of features and rules, and producible by an existing manufacturing chain. We argue that Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) AI methods lay out a promising path towards industrial-grade configurators that are reliable by design, explainable, and trustworthy. This paper describes a taxonomy of three NeSy integration strategies, namely hybrid inference, hybrid fine-tuning, and hybrid training, exploring their usage in the configuration domain. We report our effort to operationalize NeSy concepts in an industrial configuration copilot and derive a set of practical design choices for deploying trustworthy AI in engineering environments. We close with a discussion of open research challenges we consider most pressing, in particular how to scale NeSy methods from small academic demonstrators to the size of industrial configurators.
2609.29947.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在各種生成任務上展現了令人印象深刻的表現。<lb/>然而，它們的概率性質使得它們在孤立情況下，根本不適合用於工業產品配置，因為輸出必須在語法上有效，與數百個特徵和規則的知識庫在語義上保持一致，並且必須能夠由現有的製造鏈生產。<lb/>我們認為神經符號（NeSy）人工智慧方法為工業級配置器鋪設了一條有前途的道路，這些配置器在設計上是可靠的、可解釋的和可信的。<lb/>本文描述了三種NeSy整合策略的分類法，即混合推理、混合微調和混合訓練，並探討它們在配置領域的應用。<lb/>我們報告了將NeSy概念實現於工業配置助手的努力，並推導出一系列在工程環境中部署可信人工智慧的實用設計選擇。<lb/>最後，我們討論了我們認為最迫切的開放研究挑戰，特別是如何將NeSy方法從小型學術示範擴展到工業配置器的規模。
